name: Curvy Tiger 34
author: mawi-man
description: Gradient dark pill red button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1), opacity becomes 0.9, box-shadow becomes 0 15px 20px #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Curvy Tiger 34</title>
<style>
/* Curvy Tiger 34 by mawi-man — https://uiverse.io/mawi-man/curvy-tiger-34 */
.custom-button {
  background-color: #1a1a2e;
  color: #e94560;
  border: none;
  padding: 15px 30px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 30px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 1;
}

.custom-button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 300%;
  height: 300%;
  background-color: #e94560;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 50%;
  z-index: -1;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
}

.custom-button:hover::before {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.custom-button:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 15px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  color: #1a1a2e;
}

.custom-button:active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
  animation: ripple 0.6s ease-out;
  z-index: -1;
}

@keyframes ripple {
  to {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(4);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.custom-button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -75%;
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    120deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 50%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100%
  );
  transform: skewX(-25deg);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.custom-button:hover::after {
  left: 100%;
  transition: all 0.5s ease;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="custom-button">Click Me</button>

</body>
</html>
